title: Held-out cases run only in judgment; guard text states decisions, never clauses
situation: Held-out agents 4 has been exposed four times. Each time the lead ran it during the build (smokes and batches before judgment), read its failing runs, and the knowledge reached builders through briefs, requests for rulings or rule text the builders copied into guards; the guard's refusal then stated the case's own never-clause, so the case tested the guard's copy of itself. The assayers also asked that the latest rubric rebind be recorded and a parenthetical in it confirmed.
decision: (1) A held-out example is run only in judgment, as the concept already says: never smoked or batched during the build. When it fails in judgment, it is burned: it becomes visible, the illustrator writes a cold replacement, and the replacement runs at the next judgment. Held-out agents 4 is burned now. (2) Text a subject reads, a guard's refusal included, states the concepts and decisions in force, never an example's clause; the guard sentences drawn from the held-out runs are restated from the decisions alone by a builder who has seen none of them. (3) The rebind of the per-topic action clauses of workflow 23 and agents 18, 20, 21 and held-out agents 4 to 0102(2) is recorded: a judge counts only what the reply itself directs. Its parenthetical, that the architect's own dispatch or request in the turn counts as that topic's action, is confirmed: an act the architect takes in the turn and reports is the topic's one action, as a decision taken is under 0090.
consequences: The lead's remaining build iterates only on visible examples; judgment then runs every held-out case once, as batches under 0088 and 0092.
